security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU's mseccfg CSR write handler permits the MML (Machine Mode Lockdown) bit to transition from 1 to 0 via an explicit CSR write, violating the sticky-bit requirement that MML, once set, can never be cleared until a PMP reset occurs
security_spec.summary: Non-sticky mseccfg.MML emulation allows M-mode Smepmp lockdown to be silently reverted, converting M-mode-only PMP rules back to locked-enforced-on-all-modes rules and breaking execute-only and shared-region protections
